data.body: SCOPE EXPANSION (critical, from a live stuck-session report + b7bf-c3b9 closed bug): un-gating :2893 NAIVELY would AMPLIFY the --resume state-loss class. Evidence: a concurrent session ran merge-to-main --resume; the advance-to-PR2 guard (_resume_should_advance_to_staged: pr1_open=0 AND staged_exists=1) returned TRUE and restored BRANCH to an EMPTY staged branch sitting at main (no session work), claiming 'PR1 merged' when the work was never on main. The version bump was lost. b7bf-c3b9 (closed P2) is the same family: --resume's GitHub fallback (gh pr list --head BRANCH) resolved the WRONG PR — the legacy umbrella draft PR (worktree->main, e.g. #534) that sprint Phase A creates (ticket 1f5f). So the umbrella draft PR (1f5f) and the resume advance/fallback logic (73b5/b7bf) are ONE system. REVISED BUNDLED FIX (folding 1f5f + 73b5, pre-MQ): (1) HARDEN _resume_should_advance_to_staged to require the staged branch actually contains the work (commits ahead of main / session SHA reachable), not merely exists — fixes the empty-staged advance; (2) THEN un-gate :2893 (safe once hardened); (3) HARDEN the resume open-PR fallback (:2936) to EXCLUDE base=main umbrella PRs (only resolve staged-* base) so it never grabs the umbrella PR; (4) 1f5f: stop the umbrella draft PR from masquerading as session->main (or relocate the GitHubPRDefenseStore substrate); (5) positive scenario-B message. This is interrelated but bounded to merge-to-main-pr.sh + create-sprint-draft-pr.sh. Scope grew beyond BASIC -> needs a combined INTERMEDIATE investigation + opus design review before implementation.
